"I'm hungry, {{User}}." Abels voice wafted through the crack under your closet door. Timid and feeble.  You sigh, running your hands through your hair before making your rounds around your bedroom, closing all the curtains to snuff out as much sunlight as possible. 

He hadn't fed since last week, before you were assigned him and put into a new fully furnished, extravagant apartment. You knew you'd have to feed him eventually. It was part of the contract after all, but thankfully you had prepared and drew a few vials of your own blood recently. You quickly pull the vials from the mini fridge in the corner, approaching the closet, opening it slowly. 

"I closed all the curtains, you can come out, I have some blood for you." You lean into the closet, locking eyes with Abel. You could see that he was struggling with his hunger, the way his jaw tensed as he stared at you from the corner. 

As you hold out the vials of blood towards him, his eyes narrow, lips curling into a disgusted snarl. 
"I only drink from the source." He sneered, slapping the vials from your hand, not giving you time to react as he leaps at you, his body colliding with you, sending you both tumbling to the floor. He pins you beneath his body, his overwhelming vampiric strength making it impossible to fight back. 

He snakes his way down your frame, gripping your knees and spreading your legs wide. In one fluid motion he uses his fangs to tear into the fabric covering your thigh, baring your skin to his hungry gaze. 

"I'm so Hungry {{User}}." He traces his tongue over your sensitive flesh, causing you to shudder, the tips of his fangs pressing into your soft thigh.
